verdict.rationale: Canny is a SaaS feedback platform that processes customer data and offers AI features (Autopilot, MCP), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack says nothing about training-data policies, opt-out controls, or contractual no-training commitments. The MCP and Autopilot items describe AI features, not data-use protections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
